jobs.title: Advanced Tooling Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior Services Project Manager for Advanced Tooling will be responsible for developing proposals (ITO), delivery of OTR projects, delivery of internal equipment, and delivery of NPI projects. In this role, you will deliver projects that meet business needs, manage complex issues within functional areas of expertise, be involved in long-term planning, and contribute to the overall business strategy.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Be responsible for delivery of projects (OTR. NPI. ITO) in Outage Services with a focus on refuel floor & under-vessel servicing.
Be responsible for project financial performance, including cost control and delivery of margin.
Be responsible for project schedule performance. including managing internal deliverables and supplier /vendor deliverables to meet GVH commitments.
Drive standard GVH processes across projects and ensure procedural compliance.
Provide leadership to ensure high quality deliverables are produced in accordance with customer requirements, business procedures and regulatory guidelines.
Support key business initiatives including new product and service introductions, outage work productivity and quality improvement, and new business growth.
Be able to interact with senior level customers and GVH suppliers on commercial. technical and compliance issues.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in an engineering discipline from an accredited university or college (OR High School Diploma/GED with a minimum of 6 years of experience related to reactor maintenance activities
Minimum of 3 years of project management experience

Eligibility Requirements

Ability and willingness to work under high stress conditions.
Ability and willingness to pass Fitness for Duty requirements and site security requirements to obtain and maintain unescorted access.
Ability and willingness to work in radiation-controlled areas and radioactively contaminated areas.
Ability and willingness to travel to plant sites as required.

Desired Characteristics

Excellent computer skills with the ability to use MS Office Suite software and Enterprise systems.
(i.e., P6, PLM, Oracle)
Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects.Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
Knowledge of BWR Vessels and Components and Reactor Services Tooling
Knowledge of nuclear power plant refueling, maintenance. inspection, and under-vessel activities
Open communication style with proven ability to develop team relationships.
Experience working with global customers and multi-cultural project teams.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. If applicable, final offers will be contingent on ability to obtain authorization for access to U.S. export-controlled information from the U.S. Government.

Additional Information

GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

Relocation Assistance Provided:
Yes

This is a remote position

Application Deadline: November 06, 2026

For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between $104,200.00 and $173,700.00. jobs.title: Senior Digital Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Digital Project Manager based in Brazil.

Take the lead on complex digital projects in a dynamic, globally distributed environment where strategy, creativity, and technology come together. As a Senior Digital Project Manager, you will oversee end-to-end project delivery, ensuring teams remain aligned, resources are managed effectively, and business objectives stay at the forefront. You will serve as a trusted partner to clients, translating strategic priorities into actionable plans and delivering results with clarity and accountability. Beyond project execution, you will help strengthen team performance by mentoring colleagues and establishing consistent project management practices. This role is ideal for an experienced leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, navigates complexity with confidence, and balances immediate delivery needs with long-term client success.

Accountabilities

As a Senior Digital Project Manager, you will own project planning, execution, stakeholder alignment, and delivery quality across complex digital initiatives. Your responsibilities will include:

Lead large-scale digital projects from initiation to completion, maintaining ownership of scope, timelines, resources, priorities, and team coordination.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans with clear milestones, resource allocations, checkpoints, and delivery expectations.
Identify and proactively manage project risks, dependencies, and scope changes while carefully assessing resource availability and potential impacts.
Provide transparent, consistent reporting to clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring visibility into progress, challenges, decisions, and outcomes.
Act as a strategic advisor to clients, aligning project delivery with broader business objectives and long-term success.
Collaborate with leadership to maintain alignment between client expectations, project scope, team capacity, and execution strategy.
Structure communication and decision-making processes to minimize unnecessary back-and-forth, clarify expectations, and ensure continuity.
Mentor and coach junior Project Managers, demonstrating strong practices in communication, planning, prioritization, and follow-through.
Foster a culture of accountability, clear documentation, and effective collaboration across cross-functional teams.
Maintain high standards of project organization, including accurate trackers, documented decisions, organized tools, and seamless handoffs.
Manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously while maintaining delivery quality and stakeholder confidence.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines extensive digital project management experience with strategic thinking, strong leadership, and the ability to bring structure to complex environments. Key qualifications include:

At least 6 years of experience managing complex digital projects within an agency or product-based environment.
Demonstrated success managing multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously while balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and Scrum, with the ability to adapt approaches to project needs.
Excellent planning, organizational, risk management, and resource coordination skills.
Strong leadership and communication abilities, with experience managing stakeholders, aligning expectations, and building trusted client relationships.
Proven experience guiding cross-functional teams and mentoring other project management professionals.
Proficiency with Microsoft and Google productivity suites, Notion, Jira, Asana, Toggl, Slack, or comparable project management and collaboration tools.
Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to documentation, process consistency, accountability, and clear communication.
Ability to navigate fast-paced environments, make sound decisions, and maintain a strategic perspective while managing day-to-day execution.
PMP or a similar project management certification is preferred.
Experience in portfolio management is an advantage.
A collaborative, empathetic, and proactive approach, with a commitment to continuous improvement and high-quality delivery.

Benefits

Competitive compensation: Salary paid in USD.
Unlimited paid time off: Flexible PTO to support rest, well-being, and a sustainable work-life balance.
Remote work: Work from anywhere, with the freedom to choose your preferred work environment.
Flexible schedule: Organize your working time around project needs and delivery milestones.
Collaborative culture: Join a globally distributed team that values empathy, trust, creativity, accountability, and professional excellence.
Leadership opportunities: Mentor junior Project Managers and help improve project delivery practices across teams.
Meaningful client impact: Lead strategic digital initiatives that combine branding, design, development, and business outcomes.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Software Implementation (Defined Benefit, Defined Contribution & Benefits)
jobs.description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

Join our team and what we'll accomplish together

At TELUS Health, we're transforming how organizations manage retirement and benefits for their employees. Our Retirement & Benefit Solutions team partners with leading Canadian and US companies to implement and modernize Defined Benefit pension, Defined Contribution pension, and Health & Welfare benefits administration platforms.

As a Project Manager, you'll be the connective tissue that keeps our implementation projects on track. You'll work directly with a senior project lead to coordinate complex, multi-team delivery initiatives—helping ensure that our clients successfully transition to modern benefits platforms while our internal teams stay aligned, informed, and empowered to do their best work.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, operations, and client success. You'll see your impact immediately—from the moment you help organize a kickoff meeting to the day a client goes live on their new platform. You'll also have the opportunity to modernize how we work by exploring Agile and DevOps practices, and by leveraging AI tools to streamline reporting and documentation.

If you're organized, detail-oriented, and energized by keeping teams moving forward together, this could be the right fit.

What you'll do

Day-to-day, you'll:

Coordinate implementation delivery across cross-functional teams (Configuration, Data, QA, Product, Development, Integration, Operations, and client stakeholders), keeping everyone aligned on scope, schedule, and milestones
Own project tracking and reporting—creating and maintaining detailed plans, action logs, risk/issue/dependency (RAID) logs, milestone trackers, and status materials that inform leadership and clients
Facilitate working sessions and team meetings, document decisions and action items, and follow up to ensure accountability
Spot risks and dependencies early and partner with senior leaders on mitigation strategies
Prepare client-facing status updates, deliverable tracklists, meeting materials, and follow-up communications—helping maintain strong client relationships and confidence
Support hands-on delivery activities: plan configuration, eligibility rules, enrollment processes, contributions, data migration, systems testing, interfaces, and operational readiness
Uphold PMO governance by applying templates and standards consistently across all projects
Experiment with modern delivery practices (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD) to improve how our teams plan and execute
Use AI tools and copilots to boost your own productivity—drafting meeting notes, summarizing actions, writing status reports, and handling routine communications more efficiently
Contribute ideas to improve how we deliver, report on progress, and work as a team

This role is about solving puzzles. You'll manage multiple dependencies across teams, navigate complexity, and create clarity in situations where there are lots of moving pieces. You'll also be a trusted point of contact for both internal teams and clients who need someone they can rely on.

What you bring

To succeed, you'll have:

2–3 years of project management experience, ideally supporting:
Defined Benefit pension, Defined Contribution pension, or benefits administration implementations
Benefits technology or software implementations
Client-facing implementation projects

Foundational knowledge of project delivery methodologies—Waterfall, Agile, hybrid, or a mix of approaches
Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Hands-on experience with project management tools such as MS Project, Jira, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
Practical awareness of pension and benefits concepts like plan rules, eligibility, enrollment, contributions, data exchange, interfaces, testing, and go-live readiness
Comfort using generative AI and automation tools to improve your own productivity, documentation, project tracking, and reporting

It's a bonus if you have:

Experience supporting Defined Benefit, Defined Contribution, or Health & Welfare benefits implementation projects
French language skills or experience supporting French-speaking clients and teams
Hands-on involvement in platform implementations, client onboarding, annual/open enrollment cycles, data migration, or testing activities
PMP certification (or you're working toward it)

Above all: You're organized, proactive, detail-minded, and energized by keeping teams aligned and moving forward. You communicate clearly, take initiative to solve problems, and genuinely enjoy coordinating complex work across multiple groups.

Salary Range:
$70,000 - $90,000

Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if the posted salary range doesn't match your expectations. We're open to discussing competitive compensation packages tailored to your experience level and expertise.

TELUS Health offers rewarding benefits, which may vary per job function, such as:

Comprehensive total rewards package highlighting competitive salary and bonus structures, minimum 3 weeks of vacation, and flexible benefits plan to meet the needs of you and your family
Flexibility to work in-office, virtually or a combination of both
Generous company matched pension
Opportunity to give back to communities in which we work, live and serve
Career growth and learning & development opportunities to develop your skills

Why TELUS Health

You'll be part of a team modernizing benefits administration for thousands of organizations across North America. Your work helps employees access the retirement and health benefits they've earned—so you're contributing to something meaningful. Plus, you'll have opportunities to grow your project management skills, explore new delivery approaches, and leverage emerging technologies like AI to work smarter every day.

A Bit About Us

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.

TELUS is proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to fair employment practices and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager (00615)
jobs.description:
PMA has an immediate opening for an Assistant Project Manager to support a portfolio of high-profile real estate projects. This role manages small-to-medium construction projects or portions of larger programs, overseeing planning, scheduling, budgeting, stakeholder coordination, contract administration, risk management, and QA/QC. The Assistant Project Manager works closely with clients, contractors, and internal teams to ensure projects meet scope, cost, schedule, and quality objectives.

This full-time position offers a hybrid work arrangement and reports to the Senior Project Manager.

Organizational Responsibilities

Direct day-to-day construction project planning and execution to meet project design, schedule, and financial objectives. 
Support project manager in developing project scopes, budgets, schedules, and resource allocations. 
Prepare project budgets, provide project cost forecasts and project cashflow, and cost performance.
Review change orders, contracts, and payment applications.
Monitor project cost performance by preparing project cost reports and cost variance analysis.
Monitor project milestones, changes, and technical progress; develop recovery plans as needed.
Liaise with owners, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to resolve conflicts and align project goals. 
Support contract administration and third-party vendor coordination. 
Lead project meetings and facilitate communication across teams. 
Identify risks, track project performance metrics, and recommend process improvements. 
Assist in preparation and review of submittals, RFIs, and change orders. 
Interface regularly with internal departments and external clients, ensuring high-quality service delivery. 
Other duties as assigned. 

Position Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, accounting, finance or related degree; MBA or Master's in analytics or related field preferred.
5+ years of progressive project management experience and some combination of cost control or financial data analysis required.
Experience in all levels of the project life cycle including procurement, proposal development, cost controls, risk analysis, scheduling, and change orders is preferred. 
Ability to perform cost per unit analysis, cost progress reporting, and cost variance reconciliation required. 
Cost accounting experience reviewing and processing invoices, accruals, and compliance required.   
Demonstrated competency managing financial data with MS Excel required. 
Strong communication and relationship-building skills required. 
Experience with MS Word and PowerPoint preferred.   
Experience with databases and reporting preferred.

This client maintains a drug-free workplace, which is essential to the health and safety of all employees and is required as a condition of certain federal agency contracts. Accordingly, employees assigned to this client must comply with all applicable drug-free workplace requirements. Please note that, regardless of state marijuana laws, marijuana remains illegal under the federal Controlled Substances Act. In addition, some products marketed as “CBD” may contain THC and can result in a positive drug test. A post-offer, pre-employment drug test is a condition of employment for roles assigned to this client.

Additional Requirements

Physical: Standing or sitting for long periods; must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times and spend extended hours in front of a computer screen.

Cognitive: Problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills; computer and software skills; and ability to read and interpret text online or in printed form.

Description

Amazon Key for Business (KfB) builds the technology that lets Amazon delivery associates and partners securely access multi-family buildings, gated communities, and commercial properties. Our systems power millions of secure deliveries by connecting Amazon's logistics network with building access hardware, property management platforms, and third-party smart locks around the world.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive cross-functional programs across our engineering, product, business development, and operations partners. You will own program execution end to end: defining scope with stakeholders, building the plan, identifying dependencies and risks early, and keeping a distributed set of engineering teams aligned on delivery. You will work on programs such as access hardware integrations, third-party lock partnerships, technician installation tooling, and access-security initiatives, in close partnership with product and engineering leaders.

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys turning ambiguity into a clear plan, is comfortable reading a design document and asking the right technical questions, and communicates crisply with audiences ranging from engineers to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end execution of cross-team technical programs, from requirements definition through launch and post-launch operations.
Partner with engineering managers and senior engineers to translate business requirements into technical scope, milestones, and delivery plans.
Identify dependencies, risks, and critical path items early; drive mitigation and escalate with clear options and recommendations.
Coordinate across engineering teams in multiple time zones, as well as product, business development, operations, security, and external partners.
Run program reviews and write clear, concise status updates, decision documents, and launch readiness assessments for leadership.
Establish and improve mechanisms for intake, prioritization, and release coordination so the team can deliver predictably as program volume grows.
Measure program outcomes against goals and drive continuous improvement in how the team plans and delivers.

A day in the life

You might start the day reviewing overnight progress from engineering teams in Europe and Asia, then run a working session with product and engineering to close open questions on a new partner integration. In the afternoon you update the program plan after a dependency shifted, write a short status note to leadership with the impact and your recommendation, and prepare for a launch readiness review later in the week.

About The Team

The KfB engineering organization is a globally distributed team of software development engineers, systems development engineers, and technical program managers across North America, Europe, and Asia. We own the backend services, device integrations, mobile applications, and internal tooling behind Amazon Key for Business. 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Fleet Reliability
jobs.description:
About Tutor

We believe robots should be the next chapter in making physical labor safer and more affordable. But, nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t have a single robot. Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

We build robots that go straight into real factories and warehouses, to do real work, with real impact. Our robot Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Our robot Sonny does handwork, using two arms to achieve human-like dexterity in picking and packing. Every robot learns on the job, and each one we deploy makes the next one more capable, more affordable, and faster to put to work.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, we do it all in-house: the robotics hardware, the machine learning, and the field deployment and service. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

Why Tutor?

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

The Role

Tutor Intelligence robots run production on customer floors across North America. The fleet is growing faster than the tools behind it.

This role exists to fix that by building. The job is to find the parts of the operation that are held together with tape and replace them with something that works. Each project starts with a problem and very little else: no spec, no existing tool, no one to hand the work to. The person in this seat figures out what should exist, builds the first version, puts it in front of the people who need it, and keeps improving it until it runs on its own. Then it's on to the next one.

The role reports to the Head of Robot Operations and Reliability.

What The Work Looks Like

Most of what it takes to run a much larger fleet hasn't been built yet. This role builds it. That means looking at how the operation runs today, finding where it breaks or slows down, and building what should be there instead. The work is tools, data, and the way the work itself gets done.

The work will keep changing as the fleet grows. What stays the same is the job itself: see the problem, build the fix, put it to use, and keep improving it until it runs on its own.

The hard failures

Some robot failures don't make sense at first. A sensor tests fine on the bench and fails on the floor. A robot runs clean for three weeks and then stops every afternoon at 2:00. This role leads those investigations. That means pulling logs, reading field reports and parts history, talking to the technician who was there, building a theory, testing it, and staying with it until the cause is found and the fix holds.

Who This Is For

Someone who asks why a problem happened, not just how to make it stop, and who looks for the structure behind it: the process, the data, or the handoff that let it happen. Someone who, after watching a team struggle with the same problem twice, has already sketched a fix that keeps it from happening a third time, and built the first version. Someone who would rather own a result than report on one.

This can be an early-career role for someone with clear momentum, or a step up for someone five or more years in who is done reporting on problems they could have fixed. Either way, someone who learns fast, gets noticeably better every quarter, and wants the job to grow with the fleet.

Projects on the list

A training system that gives a field technician real-time instructions on the robot in front of them, built from what the fleet has already learned about that failure
Issue tracking that joins robot telemetry to what the technician saw on the floor, so an investigation goes from symptom to root cause and the fix can be checked across the fleet
Predictive tooling that flags a robot likely to fail before it does, from telemetry and parts history
Capacity planning for a regional network of technicians: where they should be based, how many, and how fast they need to reach a robot
The reliability data itself: what gets captured, how it connects, and which numbers are worth tracking

How The Work Gets Done

Code is a daily tool here, and so are AI agents. Build systems where agents pull the data, run the checks, and draft the write-ups, so the work runs without a person in the loop
Ship a rough first version early, put it in front of real users, and improve it from what they say
Work side by side with engineering, customer success and field technicians. Much of the best input comes from the people closest to the robots
When something finally works, write it down so the next person can run it without asking

Required

2-7 years as a technical program manager, industrial engineer, or engineer, or in operations or a similar technical role
A track record of building. At least one system, tool or program designed from scratch and put into real use, with a result that can be stated in numbers
Comfortable building software with AI coding tools and agents, or ready to pick it up fast. The language matters less than having shipped something that works
Clear thinking, and the ability to turn data into a clean picture that others can act on
Clear writing for engineers, customers and leadership
A degree in engineering or a technical field, or equivalent experience

Stands out

Has started something at a past job that didn't exist before, and it's still running
Experience in robotics, automation, manufacturing, logistics or fulfillment
Builds outside of work too: side projects, a home lab, something made just to see if it could be done

Probably Not The Right Fit For Someone Who

Prefers a clear task list and regular check-ins
Would rather maintain an existing system than build a new one
Wants the same week, every week

Why join

Few places hand one person this much ownership of how a fleet runs
What gets built here becomes how a robotics company runs its fleet
The role grows as the fleet grows

Benefits

Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium
A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future
Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees
Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $100,000 to $140,000, depending on experience.

Location and travel

In office in Watertown, MA. Travel to customer sites and regional teams as needed, roughly 10-25%.

To apply

Along with a résumé, send a short note about something you built: what the problem was, what you made, and what happened after. Links, photos and code are all welcome.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Your tasks will primarily involve proposal and cost estimate preparation, subcontractor procurement, financial management including client invoicing, schedule management, staff mentorship and leadership, client relationship building, regulatory agency correspondence, data interpretation, and report development.

Bachelor's degree in environmental engineering, geological engineering, geology, or other closely related field.
Experience as a project manager at environmental remediation sites involving contaminated media including soil, sediments, or groundwater.
Experience conducting site investigations/characterizations, remedial investigations, feasibility studies, engineering evaluations, and remedial designs/actions.
Experience identifying and resolving key issues impacting remedy implementation (technical, regulatory, risk, stakeholder, land use, etc.) and emerging issues.
Experience with leading a team in implementing site closure strategy and effectively managing change over time.

jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own and drive AWS region expansion programs across the AWS Mission Networking family of services. You will enable dedicated network connectivity options for our U.S. National Security and Department of War customers to AWS Classified regions. You will also work with Defense Industrial Base (DIB) customers to support and expand Amazon's new launched AWS Secret Cloud for Industry (ASCI) service which enables dedicated connectivity to the AWS Secret Region for industry partners. You will build mechanisms and processes to automate and streamline the customer experience, working across AWS engineering, networking, and security teams to simplify access to the AWS classified (Secret and Top Secret) regions.

Are you energized by solving complex technical challenges that span multiple teams and systems? Do you thrive when turning ambiguity into clear plans and measurable outcomes? Amazon is looking for a Technical Program Manager to own and drive cross-functional programs that have considerable business impact. In this role, you will define program strategy, align stakeholders across engineering and business teams, and deliver results at scale. You will use your technical depth to question assumptions, assess architectural decisions, and ensure the right solutions ship on time. If you are a collaborative, data-driven problem solver who communicates with clarity and builds trust across all levels, we want to hear from you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities

Define and manage the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs, setting clear objectives, success criteria, and roadmaps that align with organizational goals.
Drive alignment across business and technical stakeholders by facilitating crisp decision-making, providing context for technology choices, and prioritizing initiatives based on customer and business impact.
Identify and mitigate risks proactively by overseeing gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, reducing exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or insufficient testing.
Leverage your technical judgment to evaluate proposals, test assumptions, and make smart trade-offs between time, effort, and feature scope while partnering with engineering leaders to ensure solutions scale appropriately.
Communicate program progress and outcomes effectively through written narratives and executive presentations, building consensus when perspectives differ and escalating with good judgment when needed.
Partner with Business, Product, and Technology Leaders and teams to deliver value for our customers
Drive visibility and transparency of dates, milestones, and schedule throughout the customer onboarding process
Build inclusive relationships with partner groups in AWS Region Services, Networking and the World Wide Public Sector teams. Ensuring that these teams focus on our customers and support customer missions.

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing program metrics and identifying areas that need attention before joining a cross-team sync to unblock a critical dependency. By midafternoon, you could be drafting a narrative that frames a key trade-off for senior leadership, then pivoting to a design review where you pressure-test architectural assumptions with engineers. You will regularly connect with stakeholders across the organization, ensuring priorities stay aligned and your program delivers meaningful results.

About The Team

Our team is focused on building and improving the technology systems that power Amazon's operations at global scale. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a willingness to tackle hard problems together. You will work alongside engineers, product managers, and business leaders who are committed to delivering impactful solutions for our customers. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for a program leader who is excited to help shape our technical direction in the years ahead.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Current, active TS/SCI US Government Security Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers
Knowledge of NSA Approved Type-1 Cryptography and Communications Security (COMSEC)

You will also work with Defense Industrial Base (DIB) customers to support and expand Amazon's new launched AWS Secret Cloud for Industry (ASCI) service which enables dedicated connectivity to the AWS Secret Region for industry partners. You will build mechanisms and processes to automate and streamline the customer experience, working across AWS engineering, networking, and security teams to simplify access to the AWS classified (Secret and Top Secret) regions.

Are you energized by solving complex technical challenges that span multiple teams and systems? Do you thrive when turning ambiguity into clear plans and measurable outcomes? Amazon is looking for a Technical Program Manager to own and drive cross-functional programs that have considerable business impact. In this role, you will define program strategy, align stakeholders across engineering and business teams, and deliver results at scale. You will use your technical depth to question assumptions, assess architectural decisions, and ensure the right solutions ship on time. If you are a collaborative, data-driven problem solver who communicates with clarity and builds trust across all levels, we want to hear from you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities

Define and manage the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs, setting clear objectives, success criteria, and roadmaps that align with organizational goals.
Drive alignment across business and technical stakeholders by facilitating crisp decision-making, providing context for technology choices, and prioritizing initiatives based on customer and business impact.
Identify and mitigate risks proactively by overseeing gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, reducing exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or insufficient testing.
Leverage your technical judgment to evaluate proposals, test assumptions, and make smart trade-offs between time, effort, and feature scope while partnering with engineering leaders to ensure solutions scale appropriately.
Communicate program progress and outcomes effectively through written narratives and executive presentations, building consensus when perspectives differ and escalating with good judgment when needed.
Partner with Business, Product, and Technology Leaders and teams to deliver value for our customers
Drive visibility and transparency of dates, milestones, and schedule throughout the customer onboarding process
Build inclusive relationships with partner groups in AWS Region Services, Networking and the World Wide Public Sector teams. Ensuring that these teams focus on our customers and support customer missions.

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing program metrics and identifying areas that need attention before joining a cross-team sync to unblock a critical dependency. By midafternoon, you could be drafting a narrative that frames a key trade-off for senior leadership, then pivoting to a design review where you pressure-test architectural assumptions with engineers. You will regularly connect with stakeholders across the organization, ensuring priorities stay aligned and your program delivers meaningful results.

About The Team

Our team is focused on building and improving the technology systems that power Amazon's operations at global scale. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a willingness to tackle hard problems together. You will work alongside engineers, product managers, and business leaders who are committed to delivering impactful solutions for our customers. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for a program leader who is excited to help shape our technical direction in the years ahead.

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Current, active TS/SCI US Government Security Clearance

Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers

jobs.description:
Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

Job Description

Scope:

Portfolio & Project Manager is to oversee and coordinate our portfolio of projects in the region to ensure that the management process runs effectively and smoothly and that we deliver on the agreed metrics. This position requires excellent project management skills, and good communication to report at all levels in the organization. This role will help to drive consistency and standardization across global R&D project tools and practice with ongoing support for future R&D advancement projects.

About The Team

The R&D team
, composed of experienced professionals across multiple geographies, plays a critical role in advancing the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. Their focus spans three strategic pillars:

Sustainability
: Implement and scale sustainable business practices across operations, with a focus on reducing environmental impact, maximizing circularity, and enhancing long-term value creation. Product Innovation
: Design and develop new and improved packaging solutions that address evolving customer needs across diverse industries and applications. Cost Innovation
: Drive value creation by optimizing cost structures through material efficiency, process innovation, and design simplification—while maintaining or enhancing product performance and quality.

This role is pivotal in supporting the Global R&D organization to shape the future of rigid packaging by delivering transformative solutions that meet evolving customer expectations, regulatory demands, and environmental imperatives.

Key Function Responsibilities

Portfolio Management:
Develop and maintain a comprehensive portfolio of projects, ensuring alignment with the company’s strategic goals.
Prioritize projects based on business impact, resource availability, and market demands.
Monitor and report on portfolio performance, providing insights and recommendations for improvements and filling business gaps.
Support the team in gathering metrics and systems to enable consistent data collection and alignment across global teams, driving standardization of dashboards and reporting.
Secure use and understanding of the Portfolio Management Process and set up the training needed for your regions, working with the R&D Operations PPM

Project Planning and Execution:
Lead implementation and maintenance of stage gate process with clear governance implemented across all functions along with the tools required for the work to be executed.
Support the team with planning, execution, and delivery of projects within the portfolio,
ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, risk management and within budget.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including product development, supply chain, sales and finance, to achieve project prioritization and execution.
Identify and mitigate risks, resolving issues promptly to keep projects on track.
Implement best practices in project and portfolio management, driving continuous improvement in processes and methodologies.
Stay updated with industry trends and advancements, incorporating relevant innovations into project management practices.

Resource Management:
Engage with key stakeholders, including senior management, clients, and partners, to ensure alignment and support for projects, programs and portfolios.
Communicate project status, milestones, and outcomes effectively to all stakeholders.
Together with the Regional PPM Director, ensure that the NA and LATAM associated project teams follow the ways of work defined to drive growth & improvement.
Organize and lead cross functional teams to implement projects from initial concept to successful completion following Amcor’s standard stage-gate process focusing on speed to market, development efficiency, cost, business continuity, quality and on time delivery.

Key Performance Indicators

Innovation and Renovation Pipeline:
Portfolio Alignment Score: % of projects aligned with global product strategy, sustainability goals, and market differentiation.
Project Timing: The average time taken to develop a new product or service from concept to market launch. (Speed to Market)
On-Time Project Delivery: % of R&D projects completed within their originally scheduled timelines, reflecting the efficiency of the R&D process.
Budget Adherence: % of projects delivered within approved budget.
Project Compliance: % of focus initiatives in the Green or Amber range for health

Return on Innovation Investment (ROI):
Innovation financial Net Project Value: the R&D value given to the projects in our portfolio to ensure we are assigning our resources to the proper projects (R&D Timing, Investment, Revenue calculations)
Stakeholder Satisfaction: feedback from your key stakeholders on performance

Tools & Capabilities:
Project Measurements: measurable improvements in project time, cost and throughput
Standardization Rate: Measures the percentage of processes, tools, and methodologies that have been standardized across all R&D teams globally.

Qualifications

Degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree or Project Management or certification is a plus.
Expertise in project management software and tools desired.
Proven experience in portfolio and project management, preferably in the packaging or manufacturing industry.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, Scrum).
Good communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural and matrix organization. Also, must be fluent in English and Spanish.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Experience with MS Office, SharePoint, MS Project, and SAP preferred
Familiarity with Wrike and Power BI is a plus.

Our Expectations

We Expect Our People To Be Guided By The Amcor Way And Demonstrate Our Values Every Day To Enable The Business To Win. We Are Winning When

Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team
Our customers grow and prosper from Amcor’s quality, service, and innovation
Our investors benefit from Amcor’s consistent growth and superior returns
The environment is better off because of Amcor’s leadership and products

Benefits

When you join Amcor, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits and compensation package that includes:

Medical, dental and vision plans

Company-paid holidays starting at 8 days per year and may vary by location

jobs.description:
Title

Acquisition Program Manager

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 

Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 

KBR/Trinzic is seeking an Acquisition Program Manager to join our team. This position supports the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Mobility and Training Aircraft Directorate, C-130 Hercules Division (AFLCMC/WLN). This is a full-time position located at Robins AFB.

Key Responsibilities

Developing program documentation to support Request for Proposal, Milestone Decisions and Acquisition Strategy
Provide technical analysis integration of such aspects of program management as engineering, procurement, financial management, environmental management, configuration
Ensure program requirements and statements of work capture and are planned to the level of detail required for execution.
Develop requirements, Milestone documentation, and provide technical writing expertise for deliverables
Participate in an advisory role to conduct analysis, draft, and deliver source selection evaluation inputs
Provide recommendations to ensure project information integrates into existing program strategy
Employ integration, communication, coordination, organizational, and planning expertise to technical and acquisition efforts across numerous functional disciplines
Perform a range of program management activities such as gathering a variety of program information; conducting analyses; developing program strategies; milestone planning, tracking, and scheduling; establishing and maintaining databases
Analyze program activities such as acquisition program planning, financial management, cost analysis, management techniques, or documentation requirements
Compile and review budgets against actual performance to control budgets and provide for proper financial decisions
Aid in developing and implementing strategies to achieve program objectives safely and within agreed time, cost, technical, quality and other performance criteria. Products generally include acquisition strategies/plans, other statutory/regulatory documentation (writing, editing, cross-walking, and compliance checking), briefings and white papers supporting acquisition decisions at each phase or milestone of the Acquisition life cycle
Participate in the preparation of budgets and schedules and perform/assist in financial analyses such as funding profiles, outlook, and variance analysis
Develop plans including budgets and schedules to meet program/project. Support the customer PM in executing his/her mission as single point of integrative responsibility needed to ensure that everything in the program is managed effectively to ensure a successful project outcome
Support customer PM in program progress reviews and other performance reviews. Assist in creating/briefing higher level executive agency system acquisition or program summary reports
Demonstrate advanced expertise in DoD, Agency, and/or industry standards and engineering requirements. Advise colleagues on interpretation of standards within the context of program objectives.

Work Environment

Location: On-site, Warner-Robins AFB, GA
Travel Requirements: Minimal 0-20%
Working Hours: Standard

Required Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Business or relevant technical discipline and 4-7 years of relevant program management experience managing DoD multi-year production, sustainment, or modernization contracts
Clearance: SECRET security clearance is required
Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook, and SharePoint, for data analysis, reporting, collaboration, and executive-level presentations.
Possesses exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to brief senior leadership, engage stakeholders across multiple organizations, and develop clear, concise logistics plans, technical documentation, and program reports.

Desired Qualifications

C-130 or other similar fixed wing or military aircraft experience

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you’re excited about making a significant impact in the field of space defense and working on projects that matter, we encourage you to apply and join our team at KBR/Trinzic. Let's shape the future together.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

jobs.description:
Location

New York

Business Area

Sales and Client Service

Ref #

10054757

Description & Requirements

Our Team

Bloomberg’s Post Trade Implementation team helps financial institutions implement technology supporting critical trading, compliance and post-trade workflows.

We work across transaction cost analysis, trade surveillance, regulatory reporting, communications capture and other enterprise solutions, partnering with clients from initial solution design through production launch.

This role will focus on Bloomberg’s transaction cost analysis and trade surveillance solutions, helping clients analyze execution performance, identify trading outliers and support surveillance across complex trading environments, data sources and control requirements.

What’s the Role?

As an Implementation Project Manager, you will own complex client implementations from discovery through production go-live.

You will work at the intersection of trading, data, technology and compliance, translating client requirements into clear and achievable implementation plans. You will partner with Sales and Account Management during the pre-sales process to validate solution fit and scope, then coordinate stakeholders across client and Bloomberg teams to guide implementations through data onboarding, configuration, testing, validation, training and operational readiness.

This is a highly client-facing role requiring strong project-management judgement, an ability to understand complex trading and technical workflows, and the confidence to lead stakeholders through ambiguity and change.

Beyond individual projects, you will help improve how we deliver implementations by identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, introduce automation and strengthen our tools, documentation and operating practices.

We’ll Trust You To

Lead client implementations from kickoff through production launch, owning project plans, scope, milestones, risks, dependencies and delivery outcomes
Partner with clients to understand their trading environment, transaction-cost-analysis objectives, surveillance requirements, operating model and target workflows
Translate business, trading, compliance and technical requirements into clear and deliverable implementation scope, including responsibilities, prerequisites, data requirements and acceptance criteria
Coordinate stakeholders across client trading, compliance, technology and operations teams, alongside Bloomberg Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering and Support
Identify and resolve issues involving data quality, mapping, integration, entitlements, reconciliation and operational dependencies that could affect analytical accuracy or production readiness

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are currently seeking a Sr. Manager, Security Operations to lead our Global Security Operations team within Addepar’s Information Security & Risk organization. In this role, you will own the day-to-day running of our detection and response function, act as incident commander for security incidents, and partner with our 24/7 MSSP to ensure threats are identified and handled quickly. You will set the operational objectives and strategy for Security Operations, lead and grow a global team, and shape our detection strategy for threats specific to Addepar’s environment. Beyond the immediate response, you will make sure we learn from every incident by driving post-incident follow-through, turning incident trends into lasting fixes with partners across the business, and reporting on the health of the program to Security leadership. We also want this leader to modernize how Security Operations works, applying AI and automation (AIOps) to speed up triage, investigation and response so the team can focus on the highest-impact work. The successful candidate is a hands-on leader who brings structure, calm and accountability to high-pressure situations.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

Operational Leadership: Lead the day-to-day operations of Addepar’s Global Security Operations team, and serve as incident commander for major security incidents
People Management: Manage and develop a globally distributed team. Provide mentorship and training, set the team’s roadmap and OKRs, and manage on-call coverage across time zones
MSSP Partnership: Own the relationship with our 24/7 Managed Security Services Provider (MSSP), including escalation paths, service quality, vendor performance and cost, and handoffs to the internal team
Detection & SIEM: Own our detection strategy and the health of our SIEM environment. This includes building custom detections for threats unique to Addepar, tuning alerts to improve fidelity and reduce noise, expanding log source coverage, and ensuring the platform scales as Addepar grows
AI-Driven Modernization: Lead the modernization of our SecOps function through AIOps, using AI and automation to streamline alert triage, enrichment, investigation and response, reduce manual toil, and scale the team’s impact
Documentation & Playbooks: Build and own our incident response documentation, including playbooks, runbooks and training materials, and keep it current as threats and our environment evolve
Post-Incident Accountability: Maintain our post-incident process so action items are clearly owned, tracked and closed across teams, covering both immediate fixes and longer-term improvements
Root Cause Remediation: Use incident trends to identify recurring root causes, and partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security and Product teams to prioritize and deliver preventive fixes
Metrics, KPIs & Reporting: Define and track key SecOps metrics and KPIs, and present a holistic monthly view of the Security Operations function to senior leadership
Security Awareness: Champion security awareness across the company through tabletop exercises, training sessions and talks
On-Call: Participate in a global on-call rotation, including responding to critical security events outside of standard working hours

Who You Are

You have 8+ years of experience in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response
You have 3+ years of people management experience, with a track record of mentoring and developing security teams
You have proven experience as an incident commander for security incidents: leading the response, coordinating multiple workstreams, running postmortems and driving action items to completion
You have hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), including investigating and responding to security events in the cloud
You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or a related field, or have equivalent experience
You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership, and can influence peers and leaders to build agreement in sensitive situations
You bring structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations and stay composed under pressure

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. Scope:

Sustainability

Develop and maintain a comprehensive portfolio of projects, ensuring alignment with the company’s strategic goals.

ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, risk management and within budget.

Expertise in project management software and tools desired.
Proven experience in portfolio and project management, preferably in the packaging or manufacturing industry.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, Scrum).
Good communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural and matrix organization. Also, must be fluent in English and Spanish.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Experience with MS Office, SharePoint, MS Project, and SAP preferred
Familiarity with Wrike and Power BI is a plus.

Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team

Job Description

Scope:

Portfolio & Project Manager is to oversee and coordinate our portfolio of projects in the region to ensure that the management process runs effectively and smoothly and that we deliver on the agreed metrics. This position requires excellent project management skills, and good communication to report at all levels in the organization. This role will help to drive consistency and standardization across global R&D project tools and practice with ongoing support for future R&D advancement projects.

About The Team

The R&D team
, composed of experienced professionals across multiple geographies, plays a critical role in advancing the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. Their focus spans three strategic pillars:

Sustainability
: Implement and scale sustainable business practices across operations, with a focus on reducing environmental impact, maximizing circularity, and enhancing long-term value creation. Product Innovation
: Design and develop new and improved packaging solutions that address evolving customer needs across diverse industries and applications. Cost Innovation
: Drive value creation by optimizing cost structures through material efficiency, process innovation, and design simplification—while maintaining or enhancing product performance and quality.

This role is pivotal in supporting the Global R&D organization to shape the future of rigid packaging by delivering transformative solutions that meet evolving customer expectations, regulatory demands, and environmental imperatives.

Key Function Responsibilities

Portfolio Management:
Develop and maintain a comprehensive portfolio of projects, ensuring alignment with the company’s strategic goals.
Prioritize projects based on business impact, resource availability, and market demands.
Monitor and report on portfolio performance, providing insights and recommendations for improvements and filling business gaps.
Support the team in gathering metrics and systems to enable consistent data collection and alignment across global teams, driving standardization of dashboards and reporting.
Secure use and understanding of the Portfolio Management Process and set up the training needed for your regions, working with the R&D Operations PPM

Project Planning and Execution:
Lead implementation and maintenance of stage gate process with clear governance implemented across all functions along with the tools required for the work to be executed.
Support the team with planning, execution, and delivery of projects within the portfolio,
ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, risk management and within budget.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including product development, supply chain, sales and finance, to achieve project prioritization and execution.
Identify and mitigate risks, resolving issues promptly to keep projects on track.
Implement best practices in project and portfolio management, driving continuous improvement in processes and methodologies.
Stay updated with industry trends and advancements, incorporating relevant innovations into project management practices.

Resource Management:
Engage with key stakeholders, including senior management, clients, and partners, to ensure alignment and support for projects, programs and portfolios.
Communicate project status, milestones, and outcomes effectively to all stakeholders.
Together with the Regional PPM Director, ensure that the NA and LATAM associated project teams follow the ways of work defined to drive growth & improvement.
Organize and lead cross functional teams to implement projects from initial concept to successful completion following Amcor’s standard stage-gate process focusing on speed to market, development efficiency, cost, business continuity, quality and on time delivery.

Key Performance Indicators

Innovation and Renovation Pipeline:
Portfolio Alignment Score: % of projects aligned with global product strategy, sustainability goals, and market differentiation.
Project Timing: The average time taken to develop a new product or service from concept to market launch. (Speed to Market)
On-Time Project Delivery: % of R&D projects completed within their originally scheduled timelines, reflecting the efficiency of the R&D process.
Budget Adherence: % of projects delivered within approved budget.
Project Compliance: % of focus initiatives in the Green or Amber range for health

Return on Innovation Investment (ROI):
Innovation financial Net Project Value: the R&D value given to the projects in our portfolio to ensure we are assigning our resources to the proper projects (R&D Timing, Investment, Revenue calculations)
Stakeholder Satisfaction: feedback from your key stakeholders on performance

Tools & Capabilities:
Project Measurements: measurable improvements in project time, cost and throughput
Standardization Rate: Measures the percentage of processes, tools, and methodologies that have been standardized across all R&D teams globally.

Qualifications

Degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree or Project Management or certification is a plus.
Expertise in project management software and tools desired.
Proven experience in portfolio and project management, preferably in the packaging or manufacturing industry.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, Scrum).
Good communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural and matrix organization. Also, must be fluent in English and Spanish.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Experience with MS Office, SharePoint, MS Project, and SAP preferred
Familiarity with Wrike and Power BI is a plus.

Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team

Introduction

Loudoun County Office of Emergency Management, Safety and Security is seeking a detail-oriented, innovative, and analytical team player for the Security Program Manager position. An ideal candidate should be a known problem-solver, collaborator, effective communicator, and thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment. This position provides leadership and oversight of service areas; markets program services to stakeholders and community; oversees program budget and delivery of program services; maintains compliance with policies, procedures and processes, related laws, regulations, ordinances, best practices, and industry standards; maintains program records and analyzes programmatic return on investment.

Job Summary

This position reports directly to the Safety & Security Program Administrator and is responsible for, but not limited to, the following duties:

Responsible for program management to include defining of goals, objectives and performance metrics; ensuring services are delivered in an efficient and effective manner; along with personnel management to include day-to-day supervision, coaching, and mentoring.
Assists with the development and management of division budget and contract management.
Ensures the development and delivery of required training programs; consults with stakeholders; represents the organization at internal and external meetings and conferences; and serves on local, regional, or state committees and working groups.
Lead day-to-day operations of the County Security Program, including management of the contracted guard force, review of facility security assessments, coordination of corrective actions, and continuous improvement of security policies and procedures to ensure the protection of County personnel, facilities, and assets.
Develop, implement, and continuously refine standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and checklists for threat detection, incident response, and post-incident recovery for County facilities and operations.
Supervise and mentor security personnel, including scheduling and shift coverage, performance feedback, skills development, and ensuring consistent adherence to policies, procedures, and operational standards.
Coordinate the integration, maintenance, and optimization of security technologies and systems (e.g., access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, duress/panic systems, mass notification platforms) used to support County safety and security operations in conjunction with the Security Operations Center (SOC).
Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and other operational metrics for Security Program performance; prepare routine and ad hoc reports for leadership, highlighting trends, emerging risks, and recommendations for mitigation.
Oversee incident intake and case management, ensuring accurate logging, documentation, classification, and resolution of security-related events; lead after-action reviews and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
Serve as the primary liaison between the Security Program and internal stakeholders (e.g., departments, facility managers, HR, IT) as well as external partners (e.g., law enforcement, regional emergency management, contractors) to coordinate information sharing and joint response efforts.
Ensure the Security Program operates in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, County policies, and industry best practices related to physical security, privacy, records retention, and emergency management.
Develop and deliver security-related training and exercises for security staff and relevant County personnel, including scenario-based drills, table-top exercises, and orientation to Security Program capabilities and processes.
Support Emergency Operations Center (EOC) activations by providing situational awareness, security assessments, and real-time facility security status in conjunction with the SOC; may staff designated leadership or support roles within the EOC structure.
Conduct threat and vulnerability assessments, leveraging data and analytics to identify patterns, vulnerabilities, and opportunities to strengthen facility and operational security.
Participate in planning, testing, and review of facility emergency plans, continuity of operations plans, and security response procedures to ensure alignment between security operations and broader County emergency management activities.

The ideal candidate will be a highly effective communicator capable of conveying complex information in a clear and concise manner; have the ability to develop, implement, and maintain a variety of plans, policies, and procedures in the programmatic area of security; maintain an understanding of applicable security standards and regulations; and possess the skills requisite to provide day-to-day supervision, professional development, coaching and mentoring of assigned personnel.

Hiring salary is commensurate with experience.

Minimum Qualifications

The Security Program Manager position requires a bachelor’s degree in workplace safety and security, occupational safety, or a related field; five (5) years of related work experience, including one (1) year of supervisory or team lead experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Job Contingencies And Special Requirements

This position requires a valid driver’s license. Successful candidates will undergo background checks as required.
